summary: COPEL filed a 6-K reporting Board approval to request delisting of its shares from Latibex, the Madrid Stock Exchange segment for Latin American issuers — the US equivalent of a voluntary delisting from a secondary foreign listing. No price, premium, stake, or consideration is involved; the shares remain listed on B3 (CPLE3) and NYSE (ELPC). The Board recommends the move under a 'corporate simplification' rationale, with effectiveness and timeline subject to BME/Latibex review, approval, and ratification. Watch for BME ratification timing, residual Latibex liquidity/arb unwind, and any index-exclusion or shareholder-approval complications.
